title: test(app-shell): wait for the Label header to be sortable before clicking it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoGsWTi6K3WbxqLuXzG2HSKA)_

Fixes #38020

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：只改元数据列表的一条测试，产品代码不动。
- 为什么做：这条测试偶发红，把不相干的 PR 踢出合并队列；病因是测试在表格读完列类型之前就点了表头，点击被忽略。
- 出错会怎样：只影响这条测试是否稳定，随时可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

One test case, `a click on the Label header sorts the list by label, in the address, and the detail follows`, now waits for the Label header's sort icon before it clicks the header. The address assertion, the row assertion and the detail assertion are unchanged, and no timeout was raised.

## Why

The card's premise was corrected before the claim (claim comment 7225057948). The 1000 ms address wait was not the cause. The click itself was dropped:

- `ObjectGrid` reads its column types through the data source's async `getObjectSchema`. Until that read commits, every untyped column is withheld (drawn and handled as masked).
- `DataTable`'s `handleSort` returns early for a masked column, and the header draws no pointer cursor and no sort icon.
- `rowNames()` waits only for the table, so the click could land inside that window. The address then never changes, however long the assertion waits. That is the CI signature: after the full wait, the address still reads `...?scope=environment` with no sort.

Reproduction on origin/main 3df181b2: `getObjectSchema` delayed 300 ms with a `vi.spyOn`. The click leaves the address unchanged until the 15 s test timeout. Both fixes the card proposed (wait for the sorted rows, or a longer address wait) stay red under that delay. The fix waits on the precondition of the click (the column is sortable), which is an outcome, not a clock.

## Tests

<details><summary>Each reading, at head 7bba08f3</summary>

- Whole file, 10 consecutive runs under the verify lock: `Tests 11 passed (11)` ×10.
- Fix plus a 300 ms `getObjectSchema` delay (an on-disk test mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to HEAD): `Tests 1 passed`.
- Fix removed plus the same delay: red at the address assertion, `Expected ...?scope=environment&sort=label`, `Received ...?scope=environment`. This is the CI failure.
- The card's three ablations, each applied through `ablation-replace.mjs` with `blob == HEAD` restore verified:
  - `sort` no longer written to the address (`put(LIST_SORT_PARAM, ...)` deleted in `metadataListState.ts`): red at the address assertion.
  - Rows left unsorted (the list applies `DEFAULT_LIST_SORT` in `ResourceListPage.tsx`): red at the row assertion, `expected [ 'billing', 'translate', ... ] to deeply equal [ 'translate', 'billing', ... ]`.
  - Detail ‹ › order not following (`useListOrderedNames` ignores the address sort): red at the detail assertion, `expected 'billing,translate,triage,tribute' to be 'translate,billing,triage,tribute'`.
- `eslint` on the file: exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The other cases in the file do not share this race.** The search box, the row links and their `href`s are drawn by the page itself (`hostCells`), not gated by the grid's masked-column check. The search and paging cases type into the page's own search input. None of them clicks a grid header, so none was changed.
- **A user does not notice the window, so no card is filed.** For this list, `getObjectSchema` is the page's in-memory `MetadataListSource`, which answers the declared schema without any network call, even against a real backend. The window is one React commit after first paint. Measured on an idle box: the header was already sortable when `rowNames()` returned, and the explicit wait took 3.5 ms. While the window is open, the header draws no pointer cursor and no sort icon, so it does not offer a sort that then does nothing. This note goes to the seat, which decides whether it needs a card.

## Verification

- Derived gate list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 27 families): all exit 0 at 7bba08f3. `--ran` reconciliation: 27 derived, 27 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` exited 1 on its first run (7 tests in 2 files, while other gates ran beside it on the shared box). It then passed on rerun at the same head with no change: `Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped`, `Tests 5142 passed | 2 skipped`.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.listStateInUrl-36896.test.tsx` → `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- Changeset: none. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and the test file is outside its `files[]`, so the PR carries `skip-changeset`.
